basics.name: José Daniel Sarmiento Blanco
basics.label: AI Engineer & Software Developer
basics.summary: Results-driven Artificial Intelligence Engineer and Software Developer with 3+ years of experience engineering high-throughput Machine Learning, Computer Vision, and Natural Language Processing (NLP) systems. Proven track record optimizing deep learning models in PyTorch and CUDA (reducing latency by 40%), building production conversational AI engines, and scaling distributed microservices in Rust and Python. Expert in translating business requirements into resilient, production-ready AI solutions supported by rigorous CI/CD and cloud-native architecture.

work.name: Worldpanel by Numerator
work.summary: Architected and deployed automated data mining pipelines using Python, .NET, and SQL, ingesting 500K+ consumer market research records daily. Engineered real-time ETL aggregation workflows, reducing data ingestion latency by 35% and accelerating analytics query responsiveness. Optimized complex SQL Server queries and data indexing, cutting backend reporting runtimes by 40% for enterprise dashboards.

work.name: AXD.SAS
work.summary: Spearheaded applied research in multimodal generative AI synthesizing language, vision, and speech representations, accelerating prototype iteration cycles by 30%. Constructed bilingual (Spanish/English) conversational agents with NLP, ASR, and TTS pipelines, delivering <250ms end-to-end response latency.

work.name: AXD.SAS
work.summary: Designed and deployed computer vision pipelines with YOLOv8, PyTorch, and TensorRT, achieving a 40% reduction in inference latency in production. Fine-tuned Transformer architectures for NLP dialogue and speech synthesis, boosting semantic intent classification accuracy by 18%. Engineered event-driven distributed streaming microservices using Apache Kafka and RabbitMQ, processing 10K+ msg/sec reliably.

work.name: AXD.SAS
work.summary: Developed high-concurrency microservice APIs in Rust (Actix-web) and Python to serve ML models, cutting p99 response times to <50ms. Built production conversational analytics engines using Transformers, spaCy, and NLTK, parsing dialogue logs to extract actionable business insights. Implemented an end-to-end voice conversation pipeline (STT, NLP dialogue management, TTS) supporting 50K+ monthly interactive user sessions. Optimized ML algorithms to achieve a 300% performance improvement; built CI/CD deployment pipelines, cutting developer onboarding by 25%.
